caption: The drawing depicts a single object, an old-fashioned hand tool resembling a brace or auger. The tool is composed of two main parts: a dark brown wooden handle that is slightly elongated and has bulbous ends, and a metallic shaft. The shaft is attached perpendicularly at the center of the handle and is depicted in a rusty brown color, showing some signs of wear and texture. The shaft extends horizontally and includes a distinctively twisted, spiral drill bit at the far right end, which terminates in a curved, open loop. The background is plain and off-white, and the object is centered within a thin rectangular border that frames the drawing. The artist’s name and a reference number appear in small text at the bottom right corner of the border.
title: Turn Key Tooth Extractor
